original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚警方：八周内418人被杀、227人被绑架
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚警察部队发布的绩效报告称，八周内在全国记录418起凶杀案和227起绑架案，另有168起盗匪事件和51起恐怖主义行为。报告称警方逮捕1519名犯罪嫌疑人，解救255名被绑架受害者。该数据来自警方单一来源报告，尚未获得独立核实。

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚警方报告八周内记录418起凶杀案和227起绑架案
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The report also documented 418 homicide incidents, 227 kidnapping cases, 165 armed robberies, 73 cultism clashes and 49 gender-based violence cases during the two months.

key_facts.fact: 同期记录168起盗匪事件和51起恐怖主义行为
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Nigeria Police Force recorded 168 banditry incidents and 51 acts of terrorism across the country within eight weeks

key_facts.fact: 警方称逮捕1519名犯罪嫌疑人并解救255名被绑架受害者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the police arrested 1,519 criminal suspects... 255 kidnapped victims were rescued

key_facts.fact: 报告由尼日利亚警察部队于2026年11月发布
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: according to its performance report released in November 2026

uncertainties: 数据仅来自尼日利亚警方单一来源报告，尚未获得独立核实
